title: Coverage & services
intro: One trusted contact for the coverage your family needs and the support your business needs.

services.title: Health Insurance
services.text: Individual and family plans, including Marketplace / ACA guidance and help comparing networks and costs.
services.details: Individual and family health plans, including Marketplace (ACA) options. I'll help you compare premiums, deductibles, and doctor networks so you know what you're paying for before you enroll.
whoFor: Anyone changing or losing job-based coverage

services.title: Dental & Vision
services.text: Keep checkups, cleanings, glasses, and contacts affordable for the whole family.
services.details: Stand-alone dental and vision plans that make routine cleanings, exams, glasses, and contacts more affordable, for you or the whole household.
whoFor: Anyone who wears glasses or contacts

services.title: Life Insurance
services.text: Term and whole life options to protect the people who count on you.
services.details: Term life for affordable protection during your working years, and whole life for lifetime coverage that can build cash value. We'll size coverage to what your family would actually need.
whoFor: Business owners protecting partners or loans

services.title: Final Expense
services.text: Coverage that helps loved ones handle end-of-life costs without financial strain.
services.details: Smaller whole life policies designed to cover funeral and end-of-life costs, so loved ones aren't left with the bill.
whoFor: Families who want to avoid fundraising after a loss

services.title: Disability & Cash Benefits
services.text: Short and long-term disability, sickness, and accident plans that pay cash directly to you — built for 1099 workers too.
services.details: Short-term and long-term disability, sickness, and accident plans that pay cash benefits directly to you when you can't work. Available as individual or group plans.
whoFor: Employees whose job lacks paid sick leave

services.title: Critical Care & Hospital Indemnity
services.text: Cash benefits for hospital stays and serious diagnoses to help cover what health insurance doesn't.
services.details: Critical illness and hospital indemnity plans pay cash when you're hospitalized or diagnosed with a covered condition. Use it for deductibles, bills, travel, or lost income.
whoFor: Anyone who wants an extra layer of protection

services.title: Senior Planning
services.text: Final expense, life, hospital indemnity, dental, vision, and long-term care options for adults 60 and over.
services.details: Coverage built for later life: final expense and life insurance, hospital indemnity, dental and vision, and long-term care. We'll match options to your budget and what you want to protect.
whoFor: Caregivers helping a parent compare options

services.title: Long-Term Care
services.text: Plan ahead for care needs so you keep your independence and protect your savings.
services.details: Long-term care coverage helps pay for in-home care, assisted living, or nursing care, so a long illness doesn't drain your savings.
whoFor: Anyone who wants to stay independent

services.title: Annuities & Retirement
services.text: Options to build and protect retirement income over time.
services.details: Annuities that can help grow savings and create steady retirement income. We'll talk through timing, fees, and how each option fits your goals.
whoFor: Savers looking beyond a basic account

services.title: Group & Employee Benefits
services.text: Benefits education and enrollment for employers and teams of every size.
services.details: Group health and supplemental benefits for employers, plus employee education and enrollment so your team actually understands and uses what you offer.

services.title: Small Business Consulting
services.text: Startup coordination, marketing and client acquisition, hiring support, admin systems, and workflow setup.
services.details: Practical help to start and grow: business startup coordination, marketing and client acquisition, hiring and interview support, administrative systems, and operations and workflow setup. Employee benefits guidance is included at no charge.
whoFor: Owners who need systems that save time

pageHeadline: Coverage for every stage of life — and support for your business
pageIntro: Every plan starts with a free conversation about your budget, your family, and what you want to protect. Here's what we can work on together.
